description: Prepared issue verification matrix for Anthony's Saturday, July 4, 2026 second field test. Pass/fail and sign-off remain pending until field verification is complete.

issues.originalIssue: Rep-only session enforcement required stabilization for Anthony PWA/session use.
issues.expectedBehavior: Anthony opens in Rep mode only and owner/admin controls are not visible after first launch, reopen, and refresh.
issues.testerVerification: Anthony opens the exact beta URL/PWA and confirms Rep-only tabs with no owner/admin controls.
issues.notes: Do not sign off until verified on Anthony's current device/session.

issues.originalIssue: Mobile pin-drop / unit logging modal scrolling made the submit action difficult to reach.
issues.expectedBehavior: Pin-drop/logging modal scrolls correctly and submit action remains reachable on mobile.
issues.testerVerification: Anthony logs a field result or controlled test result and confirms submit action is reachable.

issues.originalIssue: Nearby Opportunities runtime behavior did not reliably use intended visit/location context.
issues.expectedBehavior: Nearby Opportunities anchors to attached visit GPS coordinates when available, falls back safely, preserves Active Pool filtering, and renders walkable businesses.
issues.testerVerification: Anthony logs a verified stop, then confirms Nearby Opportunities appears and recommendations are business-like.
issues.notes: If no nearby results appear, record location context and classify.

issues.originalIssue: App startup and Places loading were too slow for beta readiness.
issues.expectedBehavior: Rep startup defers owner-only rendering; Places renders progressively; route readiness and Places loading feel field-usable.
issues.testerVerification: Anthony reports startup and Places loading as usable during normal field conditions.
issues.notes: Record startup/Places friction separately if still slow.

issues.originalIssue: Residential-house barber-shop recommendation appeared as a route candidate.
issues.expectedBehavior: Known residential-house barber-shop cluster at 10820 Hughes Rd, Houston, TX 77089, USA is quarantined/removed from Active Pool and deploy fallback.
issues.testerVerification: Anthony samples route cards and confirms the known residential-house barber-shop cluster does not appear.
issues.notes: If any residential/non-business recommendation appears, create new Data issue.

issues.originalIssue: Active Pool corrections needed clean deploy/runtime alignment after Data quarantine.
issues.expectedBehavior: Active Pool shows corrected 297 business records / 594 Dashboard route records, deploy fallback excludes quarantined residential IDs, and route quality remains stable.
issues.testerVerification: Founder/Admin verifies runtime route quality during Anthony session and records whether Active Pool correction behavior is visible.
issues.notes: Production deployment verification remains Infrastructure-owned if requested.
